query: UPDATE product p SET rights_state = 'declared', rights_source_inventory = 'tes', rights_segments = ARRAY[CASE WHEN p.price_kind = 'free' THEN $3 ELSE $4 END], rights_native_id = CASE WHEN p.price_kind = 'free' THEN $3 ELSE $4 END, updated_at = $5 WHERE p.org_id = $1 AND p.id = $2 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.rights_state = 'unstated' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mapping m WHERE m.org_id = p.org_id AND m.product_id = p.id AND m.inventory = 'tes') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM connection c WHERE c.org_id = p.org_id AND c.marketplace = 'tes' AND c.state IN ('linked', 'needs_reauth')))
